name: The Lemon Bucket Orkestra
description: '''The Lemon Bucket Orkestra''' is a large Canadian band based in [[Toronto]], known for their wide-ranging musical style incorporating [[Punk rock|punk]], [[klezmer]], [[jazz]], [[Balkan brass]] and more. The ensemble has received many nominations and awards such as winning the 2015 Canadian Folk Music Awards "World Group of The Year", 2015 NOW Magazine Reader's Choice Award for "Best Band in Toronto" and a nomination for the 2016 JUNO Awards "World Music Album of the Year". Lemon Bucket has also toured the world playing festivals like Cervantino in Mexico, WOMAD in England and New Zealand, Pohoda in Slovakia, Festival D’Été in Québec City Canada, and the New Orleans Jazz Festival in the US.
